api_key.label: API key
api_key.help: Optional. The "API Key" of your app at developer.dhl.com. Without it Parcel Master reads the tracking of dhl.de.

api_secret.label: API secret
api_secret.help: The "API Secret" of the same app. With key and secret Parcel Master uses the "Parcel DE Tracking" API; it needs no business account. With the key alone, "Shipment Tracking - Unified" is tried.

prefer.label: Preferred way
prefer.help: Only matters if an API key is entered. If the preferred way fails, the other one is tried.

default_postal_code.label: Your postal code
default_postal_code.help: Pre-filled as the recipient's postal code for incoming parcels. It goes into the "Open at DHL" link and to the API, if you use it.

live_map.label: Live map
live_map.help: Shows on the shipment's card where the delivery van is, while the companion script sees DHL's live view open. For that the van's position and the destination's are kept until delivery, and your browser loads the map from OpenStreetMap.

postal_code.label: Recipient postal code
postal_code.help: Optional. Goes into the "Open at DHL" link, so DHL shows delivery details there, and to the API, if you use it.

companion.help: While you keep dhl.de's tracking page open with the postal code entered, the script passes on what DHL shows you there: the live delivery window and the stops left. With the live view open it presses "Status aktualisieren" for you: every 2 minutes, every minute below 10 stops, every 30 seconds below 5. A click on the counter next to it pauses that. In the customer account, shipments get a button to take them.
